cluster: Image SHA256; resample image clusters with replacement, retain every question and paired condition for each selected image; question-weighted sums divided by resampled total question count.
primary_endpoint: Complete generated answer GQA accuracy using the original gqa_prediction scorer; no Gold NLL for quality assessment.

primary_multiple_comparison_control.family: Five predeclared comparisons on the main3000-question cohort
primary_multiple_comparison_control.interpretation: Exploratory bootstrap simultaneous bounds; no exact finite-sample guarantee or noninferiority claim.
primary_multiple_comparison_control.method: Bonferroni two-sided percentile99% intervals per comparison

secondary_subsets: 2640,120,12 and six tasks: descriptive paired95% intervals, explicitly outside primary corrected family.
unadjusted_CI: Exploratory two-sided percentile95% CI, [2.5,97.5] percentiles; accuracy differences in percentage points.
